subject.title: fix(wechat): preserve existing accounts across hot reload

question: Must this WeChat lifecycle change include redacted live A+B QR-login evidence before merge, or is the focused gateway regression coverage an acceptable proof substitute?
rationale: The contributor has transparently provided source-level validation but cannot access a real WeChat provider session; the acceptable proof threshold is an owner policy choice rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Require live provider proof
options.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup posts redacted evidence that adding account B preserves account A after the reload handoff.

options.title: Accept gateway-level proof
options.body: A gateway owner may explicitly waive live-provider proof and accept the focused lifecycle regressions plus normal validation for this narrowly bounded handoff change.

recommendation.title: Require live provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR blocked until someone with a real WeChat QR-login setup posts redacted evidence that adding account B preserves account A after the reload handoff.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline identifies joshavant as an explicitly engaged gateway-review participant; stronger ownership provenance was not available in the provided read-only evidence.
